maddeler.e:
اغتفرن (form VIII)
# اِغْتَفَرْنَ (iḡtafarna) /iɣ.ta.far.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِغْتَفَرَ (iḡtafara)
# اُغْتُفِرْنَ (uḡtufirna) /uɣ.tu.fir.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِغْتَفَرَ (iḡtafara)
# اِغْتَفِرْنَ (iḡtafirna) /iɣ.ta.fir.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِغْتَفَرَ (iḡtafara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
